snippet.title: PSYCHO CASKET - STEAM RELEASE
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4871940/PSYCHO_CASKET/

PSYCHO CASKET is an indie game coming out VERY soon! In this game, you will delve into an OTHERWORLDLY ADVENTURE, meeting STRANGE PEOPLE and fighting DEADLY MONSTERS. However, no matter how much fun you have, you will eventually have to face your fate...

Can you have the courage and conviction to KILL YOUR FRIENDS and SAVE THE WORLD, or will you let everything else DIE?

The choice is yours...
